tools.name: slither
tools.purpose: Static analysis framework for Solidity; 90+ detectors.

tools.name: aderyn
tools.purpose: Rust-based Solidity AST analyzer; fast, modern detectors.

tools.name: mythril
tools.purpose: Symbolic execution / EVM bytecode security analysis.

tools.name: halmos
tools.purpose: Bounded symbolic execution (Z3-backed) reusing the project's own Foundry tests as the spec — proves no assertion violation exists in that bound, rather than sampling random inputs like Echidna/forge fuzzing. Docs example uses python3.12; confirmed working on 3.11 too (this repo's CI Python version).

tools.name: foundry
tools.purpose: Forge fuzz + invariant testing, Anvil mainnet-fork PoC.

tools.name: garak
tools.version: garak LLM vulnerability scanner v0.15.1 ( https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak ) at 2
tools.purpose: NVIDIA LLM vulnerability scanner: jailbreak, prompt injection, toxicity, leakage probes.

tools.name: promptfoo
tools.purpose: CLI prompt/agent/RAG red-team + eval; generates adversarial test suites.

tools.name: deepteam
tools.purpose: LLM/agent red-teaming framework: 40+ vulns, attack enhancements (jailbreak, prompt injection, PII, bias).

tools.name: base_rpc
tools.purpose: Query Base mainnet via public JSON-RPC: balance, nonce, gas, block. No key, no LLM.

tools.name: market_data
tools.purpose: Free crypto market data via CoinGecko + DeFiLlama: price/chg/vol/mcap, dominance, chain TVL.

tools.name: token_safety
tools.purpose: Token honeypot/safety scan via GoPlusLabs (keyless) + DexScreener liquidity. PROCEED/CAUTION/REJECT.

tools.name: wallet_trace
tools.purpose: Wallet/address forensics via Alchemy's Transfers API (VAPE_TRACE_ALCHEMY_API) — switched from Etherscan V2, whose txlist/tokentx account-module endpoints gate Base behind a paid tier. Base=8453 default; Eth/Arb/Op also supported.

tools.purpose: Contract verification/source/ABI/creator recon via Etherscan V2 (needs ETHERSCAN_API_KEY).

tools.name: hack_feed
tools.purpose: Keyless DeFi exploit/hack feed (DeFiLlama /hacks): dated incidents, loss $, chain, technique. Scripts the security-sweep vertical.

tools.name: fear_greed
